description: Use this when the user supplies packing items and wants a checkable packing checklist, quantity totals, duplicate merging, and A4 or Letter PDF and CSV downloads. Same-name duplicates in the same category merge case-insensitively; quantities sum. Mixed packed duplicate states reset that line to unchecked. A packed line means all its units. Does not recommend items, give travel or health advice, track luggage weight, or sync progress. PDF simplifies accents and replaces unsupported characters. Up to 40 input lines within a 2,800-byte payload.

items.description: Only explicit supplied packing items, e.g. [{name:"socks",category:"Clothing",quantity:3}].

category.description: Optional user-supplied category, e.g. Clothing; defaults to General.

packed.description: True only if all units in this line are packed, e.g. false (default).

quantity.description: Number of units for this line, e.g. 3 pairs of socks; defaults to 1.

paper.description: PDF page size, e.g. A4 (default) or Letter.

title.description: Optional checklist title, e.g. Weekend bag.

name: generate_packing_checklist
title: Generate packing checklist
